Laura — I've attached the evidence pack (see filenames below). Summary notes: 

Attachment list included in package:
- redwood_boundary_diagram_v3.png  (annotated; shows control plane vs data plane, inter-region peering, and per-tenant overlay)
- dedicated-isolation-matrix.pdf (table of isolation controls by layer: network, host, runtime, storage)
- soc2-evidence-index.csv (control id, artifact reference, sample audit log window)
- caiq-mapping-filled.xlsx (CAIQ questions mapped to our artifacts)
- sig-explorer-export.json (SIG export of our standard questionnaire responses)

Key highlights (short):
- Dedicated model: hardware-tenant isolation via pinned GPU pools + software-enforced VLAN segmentation. Each tenant's inference traffic is carried on an isolated overlay network and terminated in tenant-dedicated inference nodes. Tenant metadata and control-plane operations are isolated in a separate management VPC accessible only via authenticated service accounts and mTLS.
- Private (VPC) model: customer-managed VPC peering or PrivateLink with route tables that restrict access to specific subnets; optional NAT gateways for egress control; recommended use of our network firewall profiles and host-based iptables rules for microsegmentation.
- Microsegmentation: we apply L4 ACLs at the host-hypervisor layer and L7 application gating at the inference gateway. For Dedicated we additionally enforce process-level sandboxing in the runtime.
- Encryption and keys: TLS 1.2+ (prefer TLS1.3) everywhere in transit; KV caches and persisted checkpoints are encrypted at rest using our KMS integration (customers may bring-your-own-key via KMS/HSM for Private deployments). KMS access is audited and rotatable.
- Logging and audit: per-tenant audit streams with immutable object logs (retention windows are configurable as part of Dedicated contracts). We include example log extracts in soc2-evidence-index.csv showing token-level request/response traces redacted for PII.
- Pen testing: we welcome customer-led scans in Private deployments behind a signed authorization and scoping doc. For Dedicated, we offer a coordinated test window and can provide a readout from our internal pentest engagements.

SOC 2 mapping notes:
- CC6 (Logical and physical access controls) -> dedicated-isolation-matrix.pdf rows 3-7 for examples and screenshots of ACL configs.
- CC7 (System operations) -> soc2-evidence-index.csv includes our change management entries and a sample incident ticket.

Walkthrough: I can do a 30–45 minute technical walkthrough next Wed (2026-06-02) at 09:00 PDT or 14:00 PDT. Confirm and we'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

--
Markus Klein
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood_boundary_diagram_v3.png, dedicated-isolation-matrix.pdf, soc2-evidence-index.csv, caiq-mapping-filled.xlsx, sig-explorer-export.json
